classificationModel.B: container suitable with resource and tolerance contract

scenarios.title: Blocking Chain
scenarios.forcedCondition: A transaction holds a deterministic row or key lock while dependent sessions form an observable blocking chain.
scenarios.synchronization: Named database signals through FWK-006; process launch delays are not sufficient as functional synchronization.
verification: expected head blocker and chain depth
scenarios.resetStrategy: Terminate scenario sessions, clear signals and recreate the marked test database.
scenarios.notes: Preferred LABSCN-003 candidate because the state is logically enforceable and existing session scripts are present.

scenarios.title: SARGability
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent predicates are executed against a deterministic indexed data set, once in seek-compatible and once in non-SARGable form.
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate the marked test database or rerun idempotent setup after plan-specific cleanup.
scenarios.notes: Primary single-session alternative; simpler than CON-004 but does not exercise FWK-006.

scenarios.title: Statistics Anatomy
scenarios.forcedCondition: A fixed data distribution and explicitly generated statistics produce a known histogram and density state.
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate data and statistics from deterministic setup.

scenarios.title: Controlled Spill
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic cardinality or memory-grant mismatch causes a sort or hash operator to spill.
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate data and clear scenario-specific plan state.

scenarios.title: Plan Properties
scenarios.forcedCondition: A synthetic out-of-range statistics case produces plan-wide and operator-level evidence before and after targeted statistics maintenance.
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate marked database and deterministic out-of-range state.
scenarios.notes: Repository status reports successful repeated runtime validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Outer References, Rebinds, Rewinds and Performance Spool
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic correlated access pattern produces observable outer references, rebinds, rewinds and an optimizer-selected performance spool, with a controlled contrast run.
verification: presence or controlled absence of performance spool
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate deterministic source data and clear scenario-specific plan state.
scenarios.notes: Repository status reports successful repeated runtime validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Catch-all, OPTION RECOMPILE and parameterized dynamic SQL
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic skewed data set and controlled compilation order contrast catch-all predicates, recompilation and safely parameterized dynamic SQL.
scenarios.resetStrategy: Recreate data and invalidate only scenario-owned plans.

scenarios.title: Neutral client and session context
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent query text is executed under explicitly controlled session SET options and client-independent connection settings.
scenarios.resetStrategy: End scenario sessions and clear scenario-owned plan state.
